cpt_description: Colonoscopy, flexible; with biopsy, single or multiple specimens
icd10_description: Encounter for screening for malignant neoplasm of colon
denial_reason: Deductible Not Met / Preventive benefit misapplied: claim processed against deductible because procedure was coded as diagnostic rather than screening despite Z12.11 screening indication.

clinical_facts.documentation: Screening colonoscopy for asymptomatic patient age 58 under ACA preventive-services mandate (42 U.S.C. § 300gg-11); no copayment or deductible may be applied to in-network preventive colonoscopy. Polypectomy performed during the same encounter does not retroactively convert the indication.
clinical_facts.regulatory_note: IRS Notice 2013-35 / ACA Section 2719: cost-sharing cannot be applied to preventive screenings; coding-based deductible denial is inconsistent with plan terms and federal guidance.
